verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Signifyd's REST API, webhooks, SDKs, test teams and Decision Center policy checkpoints. None of it documents a built-in AI assistant in the console for natural-language queries over fraud data, drafting rules, or summarizing investigations. A fraud platform could plausibly ship such an assistant, so the axis applies and the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, the product ships its own AI assistant — natural-language queries over my fraud data, drafted rules, investigation summaries — built into the console
